title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
abstract: arXiv:2610.31465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite advances in numerical methods, non-Newtonian flow simulations remain computationally expensive because velocity and stress must be advanced together through rate- and history-dependent constitutive dynamics. Neural-operator surrogates reduce inference cost after training, but their training data require the same expensive simulations they aim to replace, making data-efficient learning essential when only a few non-Newtonian simulations can be afforded. Here, we introduce the Rheological Operator Pretrained Transformer (RheOPT), which pretrains a transformer-based neural operator on inexpensive Newtonian simulations and fine-tunes it on a small number of non-Newtonian samples. Rather than transferring the Newtonian constitutive response itself, RheOPT reuses geometry-conditioned transport structure that remains useful after the stress model changes. We evaluate RheOPT in two geometry-matched settings: a $4{:}1$ contraction channel

translated_title: RheOPT：通过对流变算子变换器进行牛顿流体预训练实现少样本非牛顿流体预测
translated_abstract: 尽管数值方法不断进步，非牛顿流体模拟在计算上仍然代价高昂，因为速度和应力必须通过依赖于剪切速率和历史历史的本构动力学来共同推进。神经算子代理模型可以在训练后降低推理成本，但其训练数据恰恰需要它们想要替代的那种昂贵模拟，因此当只能负担少量非牛顿模拟时，数据高效的学习变得至关重要。在此，我们提出了流变算子预训练变换器（Rheological Operator Pretrained Transformer，RheOPT），它在廉价的牛顿流体模拟上预训练一个基于变换器的神经算子，然后在少量非牛顿样本上进行微调。RheOPT并非迁移牛顿本构响应本身，而是重用几何条件化的输运结构，这种结构在应力模型改变后依然有用。我们在两种几何匹配的设置中评估RheOPT：一个4:1收缩通道……
tldr: RheOPT通过在廉价的牛顿流体模拟上预训练变换器神经算子、再用少量非牛顿样本微调，并重用几何条件化的输运结构而非本构响应本身，实现了数据高效的少样本非牛顿流体预测。
en_tdlr: RheOPT enables data-efficient few-shot non-Newtonian flow prediction by pretraining a transformer-based neural operator on inexpensive Newtonian simulations and fine-tuning on a small number of non-Newtonian samples, reusing geometry-conditioned transport structure rather than the constitutive response itself.
